method: Read vendor page and shipped JavaScript without running the recognizer, recording audio, granting microphone access or downloading speech models. No proprietary source copied into this repo.
findings: The page and UI describe an unlimited-use free web tool with no account, separate from the paid desktop app.
The page hook passes a 120-second limit to microphone capture; the shared recognizer supports other tools with longer limits.
Microphone samples pass to a browser worker, whose Transformers.js pipeline runs Whisper models with WebGPU or WASM; model/library downloads are required.

Usage-event tracking is present. Reviewed dictation events send event name, outcome and phase rather than audio or transcript. This is bounded source inspection, not a complete privacy or network audit.
Text lives in React state with copy/download controls; users must save it before closing the tab.
The entry identifies the closed-source web tool and avoids presenting the underlying Whisper license as the page license or guaranteeing every data flow.
